glow day cream spf 15

Contains energising vitamins and a peptide-smoothing complex of natural origin. Moisturises the skin, does not block pores and reduces the visibility of imperfections. Protects against harmful UV radiation. Evens out skin tone and provides immediate illumination. Restores skin's vitality, leaving it with a youthful, radiant glow.

How to use

Apply a small amount to the face and neck. Gently massage into skin. Avoid contact with eyes and clothing.

INCI

Aqua (Water), Butylene Glycol Dicaprylate/Dicaprate, Coco-Caprylate/Caprate, Triethylhexanoin, Ethylhexyl Triazone, Glyceryl Stearate Citrate, Glycerin, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane, Cetyl Palmitate, Dimethicone, Stearyl Alcohol, Mica, CI 77891 (Titanium Dioxide), Bis-Ethylhexyloxyphenol Methoxyphenyl Triazine, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Sodium Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Isohexadecane, Polysorbate 80, Potassium Cetyl Phosphate, Hydrolyzed Rice Protein, Niacinamide, Calcium Pantothenate, Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate, Tocopheryl Acetate, Pyridoxine HCl, Maltodextrin, Sodium Starch Octenylsuccinate, Silica, Camellia Japonica Seed Oil, Boron Nitride, Xanthan Gum, Disodium EDTA, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Hydroxyacetophenone, Parfum (Fragrance), Linalool, Geraniol, Linalyl Acetate, Camphor, Limonene, Eucalyptus Globulus Oil.

The list of ingredients is consistent with the current state of manufacture as of 2025-04.

MAIN INGREDIENTS

vitamin B3, vitamin B6, vitamin C, vit. E, rice peptides, vitamin B5, UVA/UVB filters
